## About

The YAML header sets the viewer's colors without CSS, giving a deep blue
backdrop, a cream caption band, dark brown caption text, and rust links.
Every image on the page gets them.

```yaml
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"
  caption-background: "#f4e9d8"
  caption-color: "#3b2a1a"
  link-color: "#a0361b"
```

Each option sets one of the viewer's CSS variables;
[`n-css-class`](n-css-class.html) sets the same variables from a
stylesheet, for some pages only.

## 1. Marked image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

A marked image with a link in its caption. It opens in panzoom with the
colors set on this page, a deep blue backdrop and a cream caption band with
a rust link.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![A marked image, with a [link](https://quarto.org) in its caption.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom}
```

## 2. Code cell {#c2 expect-open="panzoom" expect-overlay="rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(244, 233, 216)"}

A marked R cell. It opens in panzoom with the same colors.

```{r}
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-cap: "A code cell's plot, on the same blue and cream viewer."

plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19)
```
